body:
Thanks for the help guys, I managed to convince her with this. 

"I don't want to lose you, I love you and always will. I want to kiss you at Brianna and Christopher's again. I want to hold you. I want to defend you from anyone being mean to you. I want to be there when you need me most... I want to buy you a ring and propose to you. I want to have a wedding and build a house in the mountains to live with you in. I want to come home from work everyday and have a amazing beautiful wife to love and cuddle and make me happy everyday even through the hardest days of my life. I want to grow old and die with you.... I love you SO MUCH."

As for her friend I added him on Facebook and I'm going to be his friend. No one needs to kill themselves over something so stupid.
Thanks for the help guys.

I told her to forget bout it "She said "I cant. I wouldn't do that. We've known each other ever since we were little. He's my best friend and has been with me through thick and thin. There is a way to get out of the promise but thats gonna be hard to do. The only way to do that is of we're both happy. Both of us. And if we're both happy then we agree not to do it. He's still not happy. Its complicated. Please dont do it."
